scenarios.prompt: Create world, combat and loot RNG streams for a replayable run. Define what version, seed, stream state and input metadata must be stored.

criteria.versioning: Records RNG algorithm/version and stable semantic stream derivation.
criteria.state: Snapshots each named stream state/counter for replay and rollback instead of relying on call count coincidence.
criteria.isolation: Unrelated presentation/random calls cannot perturb gameplay streams.
